visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a split-screen close-up comparison. On the right, a woman's eye is shown with and without eyeliner. On the bottom left, a male creator in a black t-shirt gestures enthusiastically against a neutral studio background. The lighting is bright and even. (2) The creator appears centered in the frame, speaking directly to the camera. He has short dark hair and a friendly expression. The background is a solid, light grey studio wall. Yellow and white captions appear at the bottom. (3) Transition to Step 1. An insert shows a brown eyeliner pencil held against the woman's face. The main view then shows a macro close-up of the eye as the pencil is applied to the outer corner. The creator remains in the bottom-left corner. (4) Step 2 is introduced. A liquid eyeliner pen is shown. The macro view follows as the liquid liner defines the lash line and the eye's wing. A cotton swab is used to sharpen the line. (5) Step 3 shows an eyeshadow palette with various brown and nude tones. A small brush is used to apply a dark brown shadow over the previously applied eyeliner to set it. (6) The video concludes with the creator back in the center, smiling and gesturing for viewers to try the look. The final results of the detailed eye makeup are shown in close-up.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: The creator is a male with short, neat dark hair. He wears a black crew-neck t-shirt and has an expressive, professional manner.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The background is a consistent, clean neutral grey or light brown studio wall, designed to focus attention on the speaker and the cosmetic products.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Intro phase: A male narrator begins with a high-energy, animated greeting. His speech is extremely clear and articulate. An upbeat, acoustic pop BGM with light guitar strumming and a steady piano rhythm plays at a moderate volume in the background. (2) Transition to Step 1: A soft digital 'pop' sound effect marks the shift to the instructional phase. The narrator's pitch remains high and engaging as he describes the first makeup product. BGM continues without interruption. (3) Step 2 application: Another short UI-style 'click' sound effect accompanies the introduction of the second product. The narrator explains the application technique with professional clarity. The acoustic BGM remains warm and positive. (4) Step 3 and Wrap-up: A third transition sound effect signals the final step. The narrator's voice maintains its animated and encouraging tone throughout. The BGM persists until the final second, ending with a slight vocal swell of excitement as he delivers the final call to action.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Step 1 Eyeliner Pencil -> Step 2 Liquid Eyeliner -> Step 3 Eyeshadow Setting -> Result Showcase
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video provides a highly structured, professional three-step tutorial for achieving a refined and long-lasting eyeliner look using specific KAIBEAUTY cosmetic products. It balances personal personality with detailed technical demonstration.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Frequent on-screen mention of the brand KAIBEAUTY, specific product shade names, and the creator's authoritative recommendation of the items used in the tutorial.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video utilizes a split-screen format effectively to maintain creator presence while focusing on macro makeup details.
